title: MontageFlow: Physically Valid High Fidelity EEG Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14507v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative modeling offers a promising solution to the scarcity of labeled clinical electroencephalography (EEG) data under strict privacy constraints. Although recent generative models report substantial improvements in generation fidelity, we show that these gains conceal a categorical failure. EEG is not an arbitrary multichannel signal: each channel records the voltage difference between two scalp electrodes. So, real recordings satisfy exact linear identities among their channels. Current generators invariably violate these identities, yet this has gone unnoticed. We therefore propose MontageFlow, a flow-matching model that enforces these identities by restricting its output to signals that satisfy them. We find that ensuring validity improves fidelity too. Furthermore, to retain the EEG characteristics that oversmoothing washes out, we also condition the model on a physiological state vector encoded from the whole EEG window. For g

translated_title: MontageFlow：物理有效的高保真脑电图（EEG）生成
translated_abstract: 生成建模为在严格隐私约束下标注临床脑电图（EEG）数据稀缺的问题提供了一种有前景的解决方案。尽管近期的生成模型报告了生成保真度方面的显著提升，我们证明这些提升掩盖了一个根本性的缺陷。EEG 并非任意的多通道信号：每个通道记录的是两个头皮电极之间的电位差。因此，真实记录在其通道之间满足精确的线性恒等关系。当前的生成器无一例外地违反了这些恒等关系，而这一直未被发现。因此，我们提出了 MontageFlow，一个流匹配模型，它通过将输出限制在满足这些恒等关系的信号上来强制执行这些关系。我们发现，确保物理有效性同时也提升了保真度。此外，为了保留会被过度平滑抹去的 EEG 特征，我们还将模型条件化于从整个 EEG 窗口编码得到的生理状态向量。对于 g……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出MontageFlow，一个通过强制满足由电极电位差定义的EEG通道间精确线性恒等关系来实现物理有效、高保真脑电图生成的流匹配模型，并通过基于整个EEG窗口编码的生理状态向量进行条件化以避免过度平滑。
en_tdlr: MontageFlow is a flow-matching model that enforces the exact linear identities among EEG channels arising from electrode voltage differences, achieving physically valid and high-fidelity EEG generation, further conditioned on a physiological state vector encoded from the whole EEG window to prevent oversmoothing.
